title: 3 SPEED AUTO TRANS-NON-ILLUSTRATED PARTS
summary: RPO M40 (3-speed Turbo Hydra-Matic automatic transmission): list of M40-related components not drawn in this option section (underbody insulation, heater hoses, frame, engine, fan and water pump drive and hoses, carburetor, A/C compressor emission sticker, starter, distributor, radiator, radiator support and shroud, speedometer cable). Most assemble the same as production; the heater hose and radiator assemble as RPO LS5, the carburetor as production or RPO C60. Part numbers are in the parts list or bill of material.
notes: NOTE: The following components are not illustrated in this R.P.O. See Parts List or Bill of Materials for part numbers.
notes_internal: List sheet only: no parts/fastening. Hole punch in the NOTE ('c..mponents').
Items without a ◑ or RPO reference (2B FRAME ASM., 13E RADIATOR SHROUD) have an empty 'assembles same as' cell.
Title block: drawing 3965172; DR WM/CI, CK 5-6-69 CI, PREL 5-1-69, C/O A2; K382 in margin. Revision block empty; torque triangles blank.
